summary: Iteration 9 testing completed for Up-Wash Power Washing reschedule booking feature, calendar page, and released routes flashing animation. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all required components working correctly.

backend_apis: PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}/reschedule - Rejects invalid date format (400 error)
GET /api/admin/calendar - Returns bookings by date with correct structure
GET /api/admin/calendar - Booking entries have required fields (id, customer_name, services, status, payment_status, address)
frontend_ui: Admin Calendar page loads with month navigation (< and > buttons)
Calendar displays bookings with color-coded indicators (Subscription=green, Paid=blue, Unpaid=yellow)
Calendar legend shows all categories (Subscription, Paid, Unpaid, Weekend)
Clicking on date with booking opens details modal
Booking modal shows customer name, address, status badges (unpaid, confirmed)
Reschedule button visible in booking modal (orange button with calendar icon)
Reschedule modal opens correctly with all required fields
Reschedule modal shows: Current Date, Address, Date picker, SMS checkbox, Custom message field
SMS notification checkbox is checked by default
Confirm Reschedule and Cancel buttons functional
Released Routes sidebar shows AlertTriangle (caution) icon
CSS animations for flashing icon present (cautionFlash, iconColorFlash, textFlash, badgeFlash)

reschedule_booking_api.validations: Rejects weekend dates and invalid date formats

features: Clicking date opens booking details modal

seed_data_creation: Test bookings created during API tests (prefixed with TEST_Reschedule_)

Frontend CalendarPage displays bookings with Reschedule button in booking modal. SMS notification is in-app only (Twilio not configured). Released Routes sidebar has AlertTriangle icon with flashing CSS animation when count > 0.

mocked_apis.SMS_sends: IN-APP ONLY - SMS notifications are stored in customer_messages collection rather than sent via Twilio (Twilio not configured)
